title: Templates
description: Start from a ready-made app.
sidebar: { order: 5 }
---

**New site → Templates** offers starting points you can change with the AI builder:

- Request & approval form
- Team tracker (Kanban)
- Sign-up sheet
- Feedback collector with AI summary
- Dashboard from a SharePoint list
- Calculator

Admins can add company templates. Any site can be marked **Use as template**, and its files (not its data) are copied when someone starts from it.
